description: This file defines classes and methods for managing memory change events, including pattern matching, event subscriptions, WebSocket connections for real-time event streaming, and history retrieval. It is part of an SDK for handling memory events with support for scoped subscriptions and reconnection logic.

classes.name: PatternMatcher
classes.description: Utility class for wildcard pattern matching with static method for matching patterns.

classes.name: EventSubscription
classes.description: Represents an event subscription with patterns, callback, scope, and active status.

classes.name: MemoryEventClient
classes.description: Main class for managing WebSocket connections, subscriptions, event listening, and history retrieval for memory change events.

classes.name: ScopedMemoryEventClient
classes.description: A scoped wrapper around MemoryEventClient for filtered event subscriptions and history within a specific scope.

methods.name: matches_pattern
methods.description: Static method to check if a key matches a wildcard pattern.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for EventSubscription, initializing patterns, callback, scope, scope_id, and active status.

methods.name: matches_event
methods.description: Checks if an event matches the subscription's patterns and scope.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for MemoryEventClient, initializing connection parameters, WebSocket, subscriptions, and reconnection settings.

methods.name: _is_connected
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocket connection is active.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection with optional pattern, scope, and scope_id filters.

methods.name: _listen
methods.description: Listens for incoming WebSocket messages and dispatches events to subscribers.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Adds a new subscription with patterns, callback, scope, and scope_id.

methods.name: on_change
methods.description: Decorator for subscribing to memory change events with specified patterns.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Retrieves historical memory change events with optional filters.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and cleans up subscriptions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for ScopedMemoryEventClient, initializing with a parent client and scope info.

methods.name: on_change
methods.description: Decorator for subscribing to scoped memory change events.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Retrieves historical events for the specific scope.
